correctness.rationale: Projected tangent-vector dot products give the sign factor (1-lambda)[lambda(1-cos a)(1-cos b)-sin a sin b]. A gap >= pi is incompatible with three acute angles. Complementary gaps q_i=pi-g_i satisfy sum q_i=pi; w_i=tan(q_i/2)>0 and w_1w_2+w_2w_3+w_3w_1=1, so all acute iff max pair products<lambda; minimum maximum is 1/3 uniquely at all q_i=pi/3. Ordering q1<=q2<=q3 produces the stated d-integral and exactly density 1/(2*pi^2). A first-order expansion w_iw_j=1/3-2*x_k/(3sqrt 3)+O(|x|^2) gives feasible simplex area 243*delta^2/8 and probability coefficient 243/(16*pi^2). Boundaries and zero-measure ties handled.
residual_risks: Finite verification alone does not establish universal quantifiers; correctness rests on the fully reconstructed proof.
